summary: Agent resolved customer's late fee dispute by waiving the fee.

intents.keywords: My loan statement shows a late fee, but I paid...

issues.issue: Late fee charged despite on-time payment
issues.reason(s): ECS mandate issue caused payment to be credited a day late.

intents.actions of agent: Verified payment, identified the reason for the late fee, and waived the fee.
intents.resolution: Agent waived the late fee and informed the customer that the updated statement will be available in 24 hours.
